name: Nebraska
overview: Nebraska sells tax sale certificates (liens) on real property with delinquent taxes, not the property itself. Property whose taxes are not paid on or before the first Monday of March after they become delinquent is subject to sale, and each county treasurer holds the sale as a public auction. The certificate of purchase is signed by the county treasurer. The owner can redeem by paying the amount due with interest at the rate set in section 45-104.01, which is fourteen percent per year. If the property is not redeemed, the certificate holder can apply for a treasurer's tax deed within nine months after three years from the date of sale, or foreclose.

counties.schedule_rule: The "Public Tax Sale" is held the first Monday of March each year and begins promptly at 9:00 a.m.
counties.next_sale_note: 2027 date not yet posted. The 2026 Public Delinquent Tax Lien Sale was March 2nd, 2026 at the Lancaster County Council Chambers, 555 S 10th St, Lincoln (past).
counties.how_to_bid: Pre-register with the Treasurer before the sale ($25.00 non-refundable registration fee per entity; in 2026 the deadline was on or before February 23, 2026). Buyers must be present on sale day; check-in is at 8:30 a.m. The sale is a round robin under State Statute 77-1807: each buyer gets a random order number, emailed the Friday before the sale. Buyers pay by check for certificates bought (taxes, delinquent interest and a $20.00 sale fee per lien). Deposit: not stated.

counties.schedule_rule: Scotts Bluff County Tax Sale is held the first Monday in March each year at 9:00 A.M.
counties.next_sale_note: 2027 date not yet posted; the page gives only the annual rule. The sale is at the Scotts Bluff County Administration Building, top floor, 1825 10th Street, Gering; check-in begins at 8:00 A.M.
counties.how_to_bid: Send a Scotts Bluff County Tax Sale Registration Form with the $25.00 registration fee to the Treasurer's Office by the Thursday before the first Monday in March. The sale is in Round Robin format, with bidder numbers assigned by a random generator and parcels offered from high dollar to low dollar. A $20.00 fee is charged for each certificate sold. Pay by cashier's check or money order (personal check only with a bank letter of credit); no fax or telephone purchases. Interest earned is 14%. Deposit: not stated.
